LanguageData.RSR_Role_RestaurantChef.description: Prefers to use reserved ingredients in this store's refrigerator, falling back to store storage shelves when insufficient. After cooking, brings the entire order to the reception and serving counter; already-served orders only resume transport.
LanguageData.RSR_Role_RestaurantChef.label: Restaurant Chef
LanguageData.RSR_Role_RestaurantWaiter.description: Prefers to take meals from the serving counter or in-stock goods from product cabinets and deliver them to the corresponding customer's table tray; next, takes first or additional orders at the table; stands by when idle.
LanguageData.RSR_Role_RestaurantWaiter.label: Restaurant Waiter
